name: quizcraft-monorepo
description: QuizCraft - Peer-created practice quiz bank with weak topics analysis

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
